# Welcome to dfolio<i class="bi bi-at" role="img" aria-label="copyright"></i>free website

You can find on this site an overview of my activities as Associate Professor at [INSA Centre Val de Loire](http://www.insa-centrevaldeloire.fr/en){.url rel="noopener noreferrer" lang="fr"}.
These activities include my [researches](/research/) and [teaching](/teach/).

You may also find some more personal (public) stuff that I would share on a regular basis.
